q: I’ve previously given out the password for an account. How do I manage who now has access?

runs: Your list of team members shows everyone who currently has access to this account in >x< Pro, including those who have historically been given the password, as well as those who have been added as Contributors or Admins.
If there is a person showing in the list who should not have access, click
next to the person and select
. This will revoke access for that person in >x< Pro. For extra security, change your password and review which apps are authorized to access your account at x.com/settings/applications.

q: I also own the other accounts I use in >x< Pro. How do I manage the team?

runs: If you also own a sub-account and would like to view and manage its list of team members, you will need to log out of the account you are currently logged in to, then log back in to the desired account.

q: What will happen to my team members if I revoke >x< Pro access to my >x< account?

runs: Your team members won’t lose access to your Xaccount unless you remove them from the team list in >x< Pro. Revoking App access to >x< Pro will not affect the list of team members.

q: What will happen to my team members if I change the password for my >x< account?

runs: Your team members won’t lose access to the account if you change the password. We encourage you to update the password so that only you (as the owner, or person who manages the account) knows it.

q: Can I use Teams outside of >x< Pro?

runs: Team features are only available in >x< Pro.

q: Can I manage a team without using >x< Pro?

runs: The team management features are only available in >x< Pro. To add new members or change the role of existing members, you must log in to >x< Pro.

q: How do I ensure my team members keep their account safe?

runs: Using the teams feature means that your team members log in to >x< Pro with their >x< account. They can enable
for the account they use to log into >x< Pro to help keep all shared accounts secure.

q: How can I unsubscribe from email notifications on team accounts?

runs: >x< sends an email notification when you are invited to join a team account and when someone is invited to be on the team for one of your accounts. We think that this is an important notification about your team, so there is no unsubscribe option for them. If you wish to stop receiving “you’ve been invited” email notifications, you can change your settings to adjust who can invite you to a team by visiting the
settings on x.com.

q: I’m not able to add a particular person to my team. What should I do?

runs: The person may have privacy settings enabled that prevents them from being added to a team. Talk to the team member to check whether this is the case. They can temporarily disable the setting in the
